Meeting: Q2 Planning
Date: 2026-04-22

James: OK let's get started. We've got a lot to cover today — Q2 priorities, the board deck, and the EMEA expansion. Sarah, can you kick us off on the board deck?

Sarah: Yes, I'll have the pricing section of the board deck to you by end of Thursday.

James: Perfect. Tom, what's the status on the engineering headcount ask we discussed last week?

Tom: We've agreed on three senior backend roles. I just need to write up the hiring brief so HR know exactly what we're looking for — scope, comp band, the usual.

James: When can we expect that?

Tom: I'll send the hiring brief to HR by May 2nd. That gives them time to start the sourcing process before Q2 fully ramps up.

James: Good. Maya, where are we on the product roadmap for Q2? The board is going to ask about it.

Maya: I've been working on it this week. It's close. I want to make sure we're aligned on the top three initiatives before I circulate it.

James: Let's align now. Can you have the draft ready to share before the end of this week?

Maya: Yes, I'll have the product roadmap draft ready and shared with the team by Friday of this week.

James: Excellent. One more thing — the EMEA partnership agreement. Rachel from Legal flagged that it needs executive sign-off before we can move forward. I said we'd get her a decision this week.
